data.one_liner: Runs test suites and methods discovered via reflection.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to define reflective test suites and classes. It automatically discovers test methods, handles setUp/tearDown, and integrates with package:test grouping.
use_when: You want to write tests without manually listing each test method
You need hierarchical test groups generated from class names
You prefer annotation‑based test discovery in Dart
avoid_when: You are targeting platforms where reflection is disabled (e.g., Flutter web)
You need fine‑grained control over test registration beyond class‑based grouping
strengths: Reduces boilerplate by auto‑discovering test methods
Integrates with package:test's group hierarchy for better IDE support
Supports expected‑fail and skipped tests via annotations
weaknesses: Relies on Dart reflection which may not be available in all environments
Adds an extra dependency on package:test

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: Standard test runner without reflection, works everywhere
